tone.tertiary: metadata, timestamps, the quietest legible tone

rules.Text.as: Polymorphic host: "p" (default), "div", or "span" — pick the element the document outline needs, size/tone/weight stay the same regardless.
rules.Heading.as: Polymorphic host h1-h6; size is a SEPARATE axis from as — a visual h1 can render as an <h3> when the document outline requires it, and vice versa. Never skip a heading level to get a size.
rules.Heading.size: Also accepts "sm"/"md"/"lg"/"display" as aliases of h3/h2/h1/display-sm, and "display-lg"/"display-md"/"display-sm" for marketing-scale type outside the document outline.
rules.Heading.flush: Drops the block-start spacing; use only when this is the first thing inside an already-padded container (a dialog, a card).
